tbesh_subentries.definition_html:
A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.9.1;
son of: Becorath (H1064);
father of: Abiel (H0022)
§ Zeror = "bundle"
grandfather of Ḳish

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a parcel (as packed up); also a kernel or particle (as if a package)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: bag, [idiom] bendeth, bundle, least grain, small stone.
